tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'bum ga pa bzhugs so/ /

༄༅༅/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ glegs bam gsum pa/ bam po dang po/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi stong ba nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/

stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug stong pa nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug chen po stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chen po stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug don dam pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug 'dus byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ /stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug 'dus ma byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus ma byas stong pa

nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug mtha' las 'das pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis thog pa dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug dor ba myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs ba'i tshul gyis dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug rang bzhin stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug chos thams cad stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul

gyis rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skyes mched drug myi dmyigs pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi dmyigs ba stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ /stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug dngos po'i myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po'i myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rloms sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ /stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa phyi stong pa

zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa stong pa nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa chen po stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chen po stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ /reg pa don dam pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ /stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa 'dus byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa 'dus ma byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i

tshul gyis 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa mtha' las 'das pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rloms sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa dor ba myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ /reg pa rang bzhin stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ /dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa thams cad stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i

tshul gyis rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa myi dmyigs pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa dngos po myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa ngo po myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/

dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba stong pa nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba chen po stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chen po stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba don dam stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis don dam stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba 'dus byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba med par/ tshor ba 'dus byasastong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i

tshul gyis 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba mtha' las 'das pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba dor ba myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba rang bzhin stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba chos thams cad stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba

myed par/ tshor ba rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba myi dmyigs pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba dngos po myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad

mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa chen po stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chen po stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa don dam pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed bar/ sred pa 'dus byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa 'dus ma byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus

ma byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa mtha' las 'das pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldang pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sred ba thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis thog ma dag tham myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa dor ba myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dor ba myed ba stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa rang bzhin stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa chos thams cad stong ba zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa rnams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/

stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa myi dmyigs pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa dngos po myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed bar/ sred pa ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ len pa nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ len pa phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong

ba nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ len pa phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ len pa stong pa nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ len pa chen po stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chen po stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ len pa don dam pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab phyi rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ len pa 'dus byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang dbyings la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyipa rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ len pa 'dus ma byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang dmigs/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod

pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong ba zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis thog ma dang tham myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba dor ba myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba rang bzhin stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba chos thams cad stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba myi dmyigs pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen

pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba dngos po myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo'i nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos bo myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/

byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dran pa nye bar gzhag pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ yang dag par spong ba rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis yang dag par spong ba de dag kyang dmyigs la/ yang dag par spong ba de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba

myed par/ dbang po rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dbang po de dag kyang dmyigs la/ dbang po de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ stobs rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stobs de dag kyang dmyigs la/ stobs de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub kyi yan lag de dag kyang dmyigs la/ byang chub kyi yan lag de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa de dag gis rkyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'phags pa'i bden pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ 'phags pa'i bden pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ bsam gtan rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis bsam gtan de dag kyang dmyigs la/ bsam gtan de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshad myed pa

rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis tshad myed pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ tshad myed pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rnam par thar pa rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam par thar pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ rnam par thar pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sgom ste dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ mngon par shes pa rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mngon par shes pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ mngon par shes pa de dag gis kyang

rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ ting nge 'dzin rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ting nge 'dzin de dag kyang dmyigs la/ ting nge 'dzin de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis gzungs kyi sgo de dag kyang dmyigs la/ gzungs kyi sgo de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs de dag kyang dmyigs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ myi 'jigs pa rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi 'jigs pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ myi 'jigs pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis so so yang dag par rig pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ so so yang dag par rig pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ snying rje chen po sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis snying rje chen po de yang dmyigs la snying rje chen po des kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po gnyis pa/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ de ltar thabs myi mkhas pas ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa 'di thos na/ 'jigs shing sngang la skrag par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sdig pa'i grogs pos yongs su zin cing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa 'di thos na/ 'jigs shing sngang la skrag par 'gyur te/ sdig pa'i grogs po'i sug par ltung ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs po ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa mos pa med par byed cing zlog par byed pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa mos pa med par byed cing zlog par byed pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa mos pa med par byed cing zlog par byed pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa mos pa myed par byed cing zlog par byed pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa mos pa myed par byed cing zlog par byed pa'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa mos pa myed par byed cing zlog par byed pa ste/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa ma yin/ 'di ni chos ma yin/ 'di ni 'dul ba ma yin gyis/ 'di la bslab par bya ba'i

myi cha'o/ /mdo sde 'di dag ni rang bzor byas pa ste/ 'di dag ni mnyan par myi bya'o/ /gzung bar myi bya'o/ /bcang bar myi bya'o/ /klag par myi bya'o/ /kun chub par myi bya'o/ /tshul bzhin du yid la myi bya'o/ /'di dag ni gzhan la bstan par myi bya'o zhes zer ba 'di ni/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs po ni 'di ltar bdud sdig to can/ sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas pa dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du 'ongs nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug las zlog cing mos pa myed par byed de/ rigs kyi bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ zhes zer ba 'ong ngo zhes bdud kyi las myi ston/ bdud kyi nyes pa myi ston pa 'di ni/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te nyan thos dang ldan pa'i mdo dang / dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa dang / lung bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi dang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad du byung ba dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / gtan la phab pa bstan pa dag ston to/ /'grel to rnam par 'byed do/ /gsal bar byed do/ /

yongs su ston to/ /zhes bdud kyi las rnam pa 'di lta bu dag myi smra myi ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag /sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ 'di skad du rigs kyi bu khyod la ni/ byang chub kyi sems kyang chung zad kyang myed/ khyod ni phyir myi ldog pa yang ma yin/ khyod kyis ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar yang myi nus so/ /zhes zer ba 'di lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag myi smra myi ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag /sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas shing /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ 'di skad du rigs kyi bu/ gzugs ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /'du shes ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /'du byed ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /myig ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rna ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sna ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lce ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lus ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /yid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /gzugs ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sgra ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /dri ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /ro ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /reg ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /chos ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /myig gi rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sna'i rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lce'i rnam par shes pa

ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /myig gi 'dus te reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sna'i 'dus te reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lce'i 'dus te reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sa'i khams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /chu'i khams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /me'i khams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rlung gi khams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /nam mkha'i khams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rnam par shes pa'i khams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /ma rig pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /'du byed ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /mying dang gzugs ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /skye mched drug ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sred pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /len pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /srid pa ni bdag gam

bdag gis stong ngo / /skye ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rga shi ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /nang stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /phyi stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /chen po stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /don dam pa stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /'dus byas stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /yang dag par spong ba rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rdzu 'phrul

gyi rkang pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /dbang po rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /stobs rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /bsam gtan rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /tshad myed pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rnam par thar pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /mngon par shes pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /myi 'jigs pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /snying rje chen po ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /de ltar bdag gam bdag gis stong na/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas te/ yang ci zhig bya zhes zer ba de lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag myi smra mi ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du

phyin te/ 'di skad du rigs kyi bu/ shar phyogs ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / /byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos rnams kyis stong ste/ 'di la sangs rgyas zhes bya ba yang myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba yang myed do/ /nyan thos zhes bya ba yang myed do/ /de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / byang shar dang / shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang dang / 'og dang / steng dag kyang stong ste/ phyogs bcu kun kyang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos rnams kyis stong pas/ 'di la sangs rgyas zhes bya ba yang myed/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba yang myed/ nyan thos zhes bya ba yang myed do/ /zhes zer ba 'di lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag myi smra mi ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag nyan thos kyi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba las zlog cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas 'dems shing rjes su ston pa de lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag myi smra myi ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag mkhan po dang / slob dpon gyi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa las zlog cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba las zlog ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la sbyor ba dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams la sbyor ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la sbyor ba dang / dbang po rnams la sbyor ba dang / stobs rnams la sbyor ba dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la sbyor ba dang / 'phags

pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la sbyor ba dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la sbyor ba dang / bsam gtan rnams la sbyor ba dang / tshad myed pa rnams la sbyor ba dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la sbyor ba dang / rnam par thar pa rnams la sbyor ba dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la sbyor ba dang / stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i chos rnams la sbyor zhing / rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de ltar chos de dag yongs su bsgoms la/nyan thos kyis mngon du gyis shig /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis khyod la ci zhig bya zhes zer ba de lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag myi smra myi ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag pha dang ma'i cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ 'di skad du bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pas/ khyod la ci zhig bya de'i don du ni bskal pa tshad myed grangs myed par 'khor ba na 'khor zhing rkang lag dang mgo gcad pa tshad myed pas/ nyon mongs par 'gyur gyis/ gang la rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byar yod pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du byar yod pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du byar yod pa dang / dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byar yod pa de la brtson par gyis shig /ces zer ba de lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag mi smra mi ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag /dge slong gi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ gzugs myi rtag ces bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul

dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa de lta bu'i bdud kyi las kyi rnam pa dag myi smra myi ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sdig pa'i grogs po rnams rigs par bya ste/ de ltar shes nas kyang yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u bdun no// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po gsum pa/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba'i tshig 'di'i don gang lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to / /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don ni/ tshig gi don myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub kyang ma skyes la/ sems can yang ma skyes pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor byang chub la yang tshig myed/ sems can la yang tshig myed pas/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don ni/ tshig gi don myed pa'o / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor byang chub la ni skye ba'am/ yod pa nyid dam/ yod pa nye bar myi dmyigs so / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' la bya'i rjes myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ rmyi lam la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ smyig rgyu la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di ste dper na/ chu zla la gnas

myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgra brnyan la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ myig yor la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ gzugs brnyan la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ yang dag pa'i mtha' la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin nyid la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ ma nor bde bzhin nyid la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ chos nyid la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ chos kyi dbyings la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ chos kyi gnas nyid la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ chos skyon myed pa nyid la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ bden pa nyid la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i gzugs la gnas myed do/ /

tshor ba la gnas myed do/ /'du shes la gnas myed do/ /'du byed la gnas med do/ /rnam par shes pa la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i mig la gnas myed do/ /rna ba la gnas myed do/ /sna la gnas myed do/ /lce la gnas myed do/ /lus la gnas myed do/ /yid la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i gzugs la gnas myed do/ /sgra la gnas myed do/ /dri la gnas myed do/ /ro la gnas myed do/ /reg la gnas myed do/ /chos la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i myig gi rnam par shes pa la gnas myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la gnas myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa la gnas myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa la gnas myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa la gnas myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i myig gi 'dus te reg pa la gnas myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la gnas myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa la gnas myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa la gnas myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la gnas myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la gnas myed do/ /

rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la gnas myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs de dag myed pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi myi 'jigs pa rnams la gnas myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ myi 'jigs pa de dag myed pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la gnas myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ so so yang dag par rig pa de dag myed pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying rje chen po la gnas myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ snying rje chen po de myed pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la gnas myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa de dag myed pa'i phyir

dmyigs pa la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang gi skye ba ma mchis pa la gnas ma ma mchis/ gang gi 'gag pa ma mchis pa la gnas ma mchis/ gang gi kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa dang / rnam par byang ba ma mchis pa la gnas ma mchis/ gang gi mngon par 'du bgyi ba ma mchis pa la gnas ma mchis/ gang gi 'byung ba ma mchis pa la gnas ma mchis/ gang gi myi dmyigs pa la gnas ma mchis pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs skye ba med pa la gnas med do/ /gzugs 'gag pa med pa la gnas med do/ /gzugs kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa la gnas myed do/ /gzugs mngon par 'du bya ba med pa la gnas med do/ /gzugs 'byung ba med pa la gnas med do/ /gzugs myi dmyigs pa la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor tshor ba skye ba myed pa la gnas med do/ /tshor ba 'gag pa med pa la gnas med do/ /tshor ba kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa la gnas med do/ /tshor ba mngon par 'du bya ba med pa la gnas med do/ /tshor ba 'byung ba med pa la gnas med do/ /tshor ba mi dmigs pa la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor 'du shes skye ba med pa la gnas med do/ /'du shes 'gag pa med pa la gnas med do/ /'du shes kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa la gnas med do/ /'du shes mngon par 'du bya ba med pa la gnas med do/ /'du shes 'byung ba med pa la gnas med do/ /'du shes mi dmigs pa la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor 'du byed skye ba med pa la gnas med do/ /'du byed 'gag pa med pa la gnas med do/ /'du

med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa la gnas med do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams mngon par 'du bya ba med pa la gnas med do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams 'byung ba med pa la gnas med do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams mi dmigs pa la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor gzungs kyi sgo rnams skye ba med pa la gnas med do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams 'gag pa med pa la gnas med do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa la gnas med do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams mngon par 'du bya ba med pa la gnas med do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams 'byung ba med pa la gnas med do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams mi dmigs pa la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams skye ba med pa la gnas med do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams 'gag pa med pa la gnas med do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs nams kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa la gnas med do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams mngon par 'du bya ba med pa la gnas med do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams 'byung ba med pa la gnas med do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams mi dmigs pa la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor mi 'jigs pa rnams skye ba med pa la gnas med do/ /mi 'jigs pa rnams 'gag pa med pa la gnas med do/ /mi 'jigs pa rnams kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa la gnas med do/ /mi 'jigs pa rnams mngon par 'du bya ba med pa la gnas med do/ /mi 'jigs pa rnams 'byung ba med pa la gnas med do/ /mi 'jigs pa rnams mi dmigs pa la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor so so yang dag par rig pa rnams skye ba med pa la gnas med do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams 'gag pa med pa la

gnas med do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa la gnas med do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams mngon par 'du bya ba med pa la gnas med do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams 'byung ba med pa la gnas med do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams mi dmigs pa la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor byams pa chen po skye ba med pa la gnas med do/ /byams pa chen po 'gag pa med pa la gnas med do/ /byams pa chen po kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa la gnas med do/ /byams pa chen po mngon par 'du bya ba med pa la gnas med do/ /byams pa chen po 'byung ba med pa la gnas med do/ /byams pa chen po mi dmigs pa la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor snying rje chen po skye ba med pa la gnas med do/ /snying rje chen po 'gag pa med pa la gnas med do/ /snying rje chen po kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa la gnas med do/ /snying rje chen po mngon par 'du bya ba med pa la gnas med do/ /snying rje chen po 'byung ba med pa la gnas med do/ /snying rje chen po mi dmigs pa la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams skye ba med pa la gnas med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams 'gag pa med pa la gnas med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa la gnas med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams mngon par 'du bya ba med pa la gnas med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams 'byung ba med pa la gnas med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams mi dmigs pa la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ gzugs shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /tshor ba shin tu rnam

par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /'du shes shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /'du byed shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rnam par shes pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ mig shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rna ba shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /sna shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /lce shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /lus shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /yid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ gzugs shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /sgra shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /dri shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /ro shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /reg shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /chos shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ mig gi rnam par shes pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /sna'i rnam par

shes pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rab 'byor

de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sa'i khams shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /chu'i khams shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /mye'i khams shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rlung gi khams shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /nam mkha'i khams shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ ma rig pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /'du byed shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rnam par shes pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /mying dang gzugs shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /skye mched drug shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /reg pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /tshor ba shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /sred pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /len pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /srid pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /skye ba shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rga shi shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa

la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med do// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po lnga pa/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ nang stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas

myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /dbang po shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /stobs shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ 'phags pa'i bden pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /bsam gtan shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /tshad myed pa shin tu rnam par

dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rnam par thar pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /mngon par shes pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /snying rje chen po shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ bdag myed pa'i phyir/ bdag shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sems can myed pa'i phyir/ sems can shin tu rnam par dag

pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ srog myed pa'i phyir/ srog shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ gso ba med pa'i phyir/ gso ba shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ skyes bu myed pa'i phyir/ skyes bu shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ gang zag myed pa'i phyir/ gang zag shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ shed can med pa'i phyir/ shed can shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ shed bdag med pa'i phyir/ shed bdag shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rab 'byor

de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ byed pa po myed pa'i phyir/ byed pa po shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ tshor ba po med pa'i phyir/ tshor ba po shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ shes pa po myed pa'i phyir/ shes pa po shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ mthong ba po myed pa'i phyir/ mthong ba po shin tu rnam par dag pa la mtshan ma'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mngon par 'char ba'i tshe/ mun pa'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ bskal pa'i mye 'bar ba'i tshe/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad kyi gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims la tshul khrims ngan pa'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'khrug pa'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi shes rab la/ shes rab 'chal pa'i gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par grol ba la rnam par ma grol ba 'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa la rnam par ma grol ba'i ye shes ma gzigs pa'i gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems

dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ gza' dang / skar ma dang / nor bu rin po che dang / glog gi 'od la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi 'od la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi 'od la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ mtshe ma'i lha rnams kyi 'od la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyi 'od la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ 'phrul dga'i lha rnams kyi 'od la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la
