ba myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa bstong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa med cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ /zag pa myed cings khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dbang po rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /stobs rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang rang bzhin

stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams kying rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khangs su chud pa myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su cung pa myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa med do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chung pa myed do/ /snying rje chen po yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin

stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bdun pa/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu ji skad du smras pa de bzhin te/ gzugs kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa med do/ /tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /'du shes kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /'du byed kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam pa shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /myig kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rna ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sna yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lce yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lus kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /yid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /gzugs kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sgra yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ /zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dri yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /ro yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /reg kyang rang bzhin

kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang rang

bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chung pa myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /snying rje chen po yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su cud pa myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gang yang khyod kyis 'di skad du/ sems myed pa'i phyir/ sems de la yang chags pa myed do zhes smras pa ni de lta yin te/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor der yang ma zad do/

gzugs myed pa yang gzugs la chags pa myed do/ /tshor ba myed pa yang tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /'du shes myed pa yang 'du shes la chags pa myed do/ /'du byed myed pa yang 'du byed la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed pa yang rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /myig myed pa yang myig la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba myed pa yang rna ba la chags pa myed do/ /sna myed pa yang sna la chags pa myed do/ /lce myed pa yang lce la chags pa myed do/ /lus myed pa yang lus la chags pa myed do/ /yid myed pa yang yid la chags pa myed do/ /gzugs myed pa yang gzugs la chags pa myed do/ /sgra myed pa yang sgra la chags pa myed do/ /dri myed pa yang dri la chags pa myed do/ /ro myed pa yang ro la chags pa myed do/ /reg myed pa yang reg la chags pa myed do/ /chos myed pa yang chos la chags pa myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa myed pa yang myig gi rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myed pa yang rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa myed pa yang sna'i rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa myed pa yang lce'i rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed pa yang lus kyi rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed pa yang yid kyi rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang myig gi 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang sna'i 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang lca'i 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba

myed pa yang myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung 'bi tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /sa'i khams myed pa yang sa'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /chu'i khams myed pa yang chu'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /mye'i khams myed pa yang mye'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /rlung gi khams myed pa yang rlung gi khams la chags pa myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams myed pa yang nam mkha'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams myed pa yang rnam pa shes pa'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /ma rig pa myed pa yang ma rig pa la chags pa myed do/ /'du byed myed pa yang 'du byed la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed pa yang rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /mying dang gzugs myed pa yang mying dang gzugs la chags pa myed do/ /skye mched drug myed pa yang skye mched drug la chags pa myed do/ /reg pa myed pa yang reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /tshor ba myed pa yang tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /sred pa myed pa yang srid pa la chags pa myed do/ /len pa myed pa yang len pa la chags pa myed do/ /srid pa myed pa yang srid pa la chags pa myed do/ /skye ba myed pa yang skye ba la chags pa myed do/ /rga shi myed pa yang rga shi la chags pa myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu

phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid myed pa yang nang stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid myed pa yang phyi stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid myed pa yang phyi nang stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myed pa yang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid myed pa yang chen po stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid myed pa yang don dam pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid myed pa yang 'dus byas stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myed pa yang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myed pa yang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid med pa yang thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myed pa yang dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid myed pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid myed pa yang chos thams cad stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myed pa yang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myed pa yang myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid myed pa yang dngos po myed pa stong pa

nyid la chags pa myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed pa yang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed pa la yang dngos po myed pa yang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa myed pa yang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba myed pa yang yang dag par spong ba rnams la chags pa myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa myed pa yang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /dbang po myed pa yang dbang po rnams la chags pa myed do/ /stobs myed pa yang stobs rnams la chags pa myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag myed pa yang byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la chags pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed pa yang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la chags pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa myed pa yang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /bsam gtan myed pa yang bsam gtan rnams la chags pa myed do/ /tshad med pa myed pa yang tshad myed pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa myed pa yang gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa myed pa yang rnam par thar pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa myed pa yang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa myed pa yang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la chags pa myed do/ /mngon par shes pa myed pa yang mngon par shes pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin med pa yang ting nge 'dzin rnams la chags pa myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo myed pa yang gzungs kyi sgo rnams la

chags pa myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs myed pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la chags pa myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa myed pa yang myi 'jigs pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa myed pa yang so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /byams pa chen po myed pa yang byams pa chen po la chags pa myed do/ /snying rje chen po myed pa yang snying rje chen po la chags pa myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa myed pa yang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid med pa yang thams cad shes pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myed pa yang lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid med pa yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de de bzhin te/ gzugs myed pa yang gzugs la chags pa myed do/ /tshor ba myed pa yang tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /'du shes myed pa yang 'du shes la chags pa myed do/ /'du byed myed pa yang 'du byed la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed pa yang rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /myig myed pa yang myig la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba myed pa yang rna ba la chags pa med do/ /sna myed pa yang sna la chags pa myed do/ /lce myed pa yang lce la chags pa myed do/ /lus med pa yang lus la chags pa myed do/ /yid med pa yang yid la chags pa med do/ /gzugs med pa yang gzugs la chags pa myed do/ /sgra myed pa yang sgra la chags pa med do/ /dri myed pa yang dri la chags pa myed do/ /ro myed pa yang rol chags pa myed do/ /reg pa med pa yang reg pa la chags pa med do/ /chos myed pa yang chos la chags pa myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa myed pa yang myig gi rnam

par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam pa shes pa myed pa yang rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa myed pa yang sna'i rnam par shes pa la chags pa med do/ /lce'i rnam pa shes pa myed pa yang lce'i rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed pa yang lus kyi rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed pa yang yid kyi rnam par shes pa la chags pa med do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang myig gi 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang sna'i 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa la yang lce'i 'dus te reg pa la chags pa med do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la chags pa med do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba las chags pa med do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byug ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung pa'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba med pa yang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa med do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /sa'i khams med pa yang sa'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /chu'i khams

myed pa yang chu'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /mye'i khams myed pa yang mye'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /rlung gi khams myed pa yang rlung gi khams la chags pa myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams myed pa yang nam mkha'i khams la chags pa med do/ /rnam pa shes pa'i khams myed pa yang rnam pa shes pa'i khams la chags pa med do/ /ma rig pa med pa yang ma rig pa la chags pa myed do/ /'du byed myed pa yang 'du byed la chags pa myed do/ /rnam pa shes pa myed pa yang rnam pa shes pa la chags pa med do/ /mying dang gzugs med pa yang ming pa yang ming dang gzugs la chags pa myed do/ /skye mched drug myed pa yang skye mched drug la chags pa myed do/ /reg pa myed pa yang reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /tshor ba med pa yang tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /sred pa myed pa yang sred pa la cags pa myed do/ /len pa med pa yang len pa la chags pa myed do/ /srid pa myed pa yang srid pa la chags pa myed do/ /skye ba myed pa yag skye ba la chags pa myed do/ /rga shi myed pa yang rga shi la chags pa myid do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu pyin pa med pa yang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa med pa yang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa med pa yang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid med pa yang nang stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid myed pa yang phyi stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid myed pa

yang phyi nang stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid med pa yang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid myed pa yang chen po stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid med pa yang don dam pa stong pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid med pa yang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid med pa yang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid med pa yang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /thog ma dang thams ma med pa stong pa nyid myed pa yang thog ma dang tham myed pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid med pa yang dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid med pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid med pa yang chos thams cad stong pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid med pa yang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid med pa yang mi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid med pa yang dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid med pa yang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid med pa yang dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa med pa yang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /yang dag par spong ba med pa yang yang dag par spong ba rnams la chags pa med do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa myed pa yang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /dbang po med pa yang dbang po rnams la chags pa med do/ /stobs med pa yang stobs

rnams la chags pa myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag myed pa yang byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la chags pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed pa yang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag rnams la chags pa med do/ /'phags pa'i bde pa med pa yang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /bsam gtan med pa yang bsam gtan rnams la chags pa med do/ /tshad med pa med pa yang tshad med pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa med pa yang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /rnam par thar pa med pa yang rnam par thar pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa med pa yang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa la chags pa med do/ /mngon par shes pa med pa yang mngon par shes pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin med pa yang ting nge 'dzin rnams la chags pa med do/ /gzungs kyi sgo med pa yang gzungs kyi sgo rnams la chags pa med do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs med pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la chags pa med do/ /myi 'jigs pa myed pa yang mi 'jigs pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa myed pa yang so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /byams pa chen po myed pa yang byams pa chen po la chags pa myed do/ /snying rje chen po myed pa yang snying rje chen po la chags pa med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa med pa yang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid med pa yang

thams cad shes pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid med pa yang lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myed pa yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar spyod pa ni byang chub kyi sems mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i sems/ nyan thos dang/ /rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sems des kyang chos thams cad la dmyigs pa myed pa'i tshul gyis rlom sems su 'gyur ba myed/ mngon par chags par 'gyur ba med pas de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa byams gang gi bus/ /bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das don gang gi slad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi ba de la bdag kyang spobs pa skye'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang po khyod kyis spobs pa skyed cig/ gang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni go cha chen po bgos pa'i sems can lags te/ bcom ldan 'das de ni theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i sems can lags la/ de ni theg pa chen po la yang dag par gnas pa'i sems can lags pas/ de'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus/ tshe dang ldan pa byams gang gi bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po ci tsam gyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos go cha chen po bgos zhes bya/ gang pos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sems can nyung zad nyi tse'i zhig gi don du

sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba ma yin gyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ngo / /sems can nyung zad nyi tse'i phyir/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / tshul khrims srung ba ma yin gyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing tshul khrims srung ngo / /sems can nyung zad nyi tse'i phyir/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / bzod pa sgom pa ma yin gyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing/ bzod pa sgom mo/ /sems can nyung zad nyi tse'i phyir/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / brtson 'grus rtsom pa ma yin gyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems can nyung zad nyi tse'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / bsam gtan skyed pa ma yin gyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / bsam gtan skyed do/ /sems can nyung zad nyi tse'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / shes rab sgom pa ma yin gyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / shes rab sgom mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sems can 'di snyed cig phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bya'o/ /sems can 'di snyed cig ni yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar myi bya'o zhe'am/ sems can 'di snyed cig ni byang chub tu dgod par bya'o/ /sems can 'di snyed cig ni byang chub tu dgod par mi bya'o zhes sems can yongs su dpag pas go cha mi gyon gyi/

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sems can thams cad kyi don du go cha chen po gyon to/ /de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang nang stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang phyi stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang phyi stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang phyi nang stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang chen po stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems

can thams cad kyang don dam pa stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang don dam pa stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang 'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang 'dus byas stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang chos thams cad stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang mi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis

kyang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang yang dag par spong ba bzhi la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang yang dag par spong ba bzhi la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang dbang po lnga la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang dbang po lnga la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang stobs lnga la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang stobs lnga la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la gnas par bya'o//sems can thams cad kyang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang bsam gtan rnams la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang bsam gtan rnams la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang tshad myed pa rnams la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang tshad med pa rnams la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par

'jug pa rnams la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang rnam par thar pa brgyad la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang rnam par thar pa brgyad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang rnam pa thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang mngon par shes pa rnams la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang mngon par shes pa rnams la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang ting nge 'dzin rnams la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang ting nge 'dzin rnams la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang gzungs kyi sgo rnams la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang gzungs kyi sgo rnams la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang myi 'jigs pa bzhi la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang myi 'jigs pa bzhi la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang snying rje chen po la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang snying rje chen po la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhes bya bar sems bskyed de/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa

ti'i bu de tsam gyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa gang yongs su gtong ba de dag nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas yongs su gtong ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i don tu yongs su myi sngo ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhing / chos de dag la bzod pa dang / mos pa dang / rten pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas brtson

'grus nyam par myi byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shar dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ 'di ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sems rtse gcig tu byed cing/ /de la dmyigs pa gcig pa'i phyir/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa rnams kyi go mi 'byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas chos thams cad sgyu mar byas pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas te/ des sbyin pa yang mi dmyigs/ gtong ba yang myi dmyigs/ len pa yang mi dmyigs pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ pha rol tu phyin pa de dag la mtshan mar mi byed cing mi dmyigs pa de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i go cha chen po bgos par shes par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya

bas sbyin pa gang yongs su gtong ba de/ sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis yongs su sngo ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyis la yang mos pa myi skyed na/ so so'i skye bo'i sa la lta smos kyang mi smos pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / chos de dag la bzod pa dang mos pa dang / rten pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / brtson 'grus nyam par mi byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing gnas pa'i tshe/

nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sems kyi go myi 'byed cing dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang / sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad sgyu mar byas pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas shing / tshul khrims des rlom sems su mi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ tshul khrims de yang mi dmyigs shing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar spyod pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug po thams cad yongs su 'dzin te/ de'i phyir go cha chen po bgos zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bsam yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sbyin pa yongs su gtong ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu

yongs su bsngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshul khrims yongs su srung zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas chos de dag la bzod pa dang / mos pa dang / rten pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / brtson 'grus nyam par myi byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams

cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sems rtse gcig tu byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing /chos thams cad la sgyu mar byas pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas te/ bzod pa des rlom sems su mi byed cing / bzod pa mi dmyigs pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar spyod pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug po thams cad yongs su 'dzin te/ de'i phyir go cha chen po bgos zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam

pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshul khrims yongs su srung zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / chos de dag la de ltar bzod pa dang / mos pa dang / rten pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sems can thams cad kyi don tu brtson 'grus nyam par mi byed cing / brtun mi ngas pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ sems rtse gcig tu byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen

po/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ chos thams cad sgyu mar byas pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas te/ brtson 'grus des rlom sems su myi byed cing / brtson 'grus de yang myi dmyigs te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar spyod pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug po thams cad yongs su 'dzin te/ de'i phyir go cha chenacen po bgos zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod

cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshul khrims srung zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ bzod pa yongs su sgom ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / brtson 'grus nyam par mi byed de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang / sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems

dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba la sems rtse gcig tu byed de/ de la dmigs pa gcig pa'i phyir/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba rnams kyi go myi 'byed cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing/ /chos thams cad la sgyu mar byas pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas te/ bsam gtan des kyang rlom sems su myi byed cing / bsam gtan de yang mi dmigs te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang / sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar spyod pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug po thams cad yongs su 'dzin te/ de'i phyir go cha chen po bgos zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i sbyin

nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ brtson 'grus nyam par mi byed cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sems rtse gcig tu byed cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / chos thams cad la sgyu mar byas pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas te/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rlom sems su mi byed de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis pha rol

tu phyin pa 'di dag dang / sems can dang / byang chub la mtshan mar myi byed mi dmigs pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi go cha chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa re re la gnas shing / pha rol tu phyin pa drug po thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la yang mnyam par gzhog ste/ bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi ro yang myong bar myi byed do/ /bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis kyang mi 'phrogs te/ /bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i dbang gis kyang mi skye'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thabs mkhas pa dang 'grogs pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dag la dben pa mthong ba dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa mthong bas mnyam par gzhog ste/ de dag gi dbang gis kyang mi skye/ yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du yang mi byed de/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyang zil gyis gnon to/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i thabs mkhas pa'i go cha chen po ste/

tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po brgyad pa/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar go cha chen po bgos pa la shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing / ming yongs su sgrog pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su su smyind par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam pa rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing / ming yongs su sgrog pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su su smyind par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam pa rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go /nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing / mying yongs su sgrog pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su smyind par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phral gyis rnam pa rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing

dbyangs rjes su sgrog go /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing mying yongs su sgrog pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su smyi nad par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam pa rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go /byang shar kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing mying yongs su sgrog pa mdzad do/ /'jig rten gyi khams che mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su smyi nad par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam pa rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing mying yongs su sgrog pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su smyi nad par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam pa rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing myid yongs su sgrog pa mdzad do/

'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos po 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su smyin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam pa rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing mying yongs su sgrog pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su smyin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam pa rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go /'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing mying yongs su sgrog pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su smyind par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam pa rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing mying yongs su sgrog pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su smyin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam pa rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go/ smras pa/ tshe dang

ldan pa gang po ci tsam gyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs zhes bya/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni gang yin/ /gang pos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod de/ de sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / 'dod pas dben sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rnam par rtog pa myed pa/ rnam par dpyod pa myed pa/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang snyoms su gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa bde ba la rnam par spyod pa btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal ba yang spangs shing yid bde ba dang / yid myi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas/ bde ba yang myed/ sdug bsngal yang myed pa/ btang snyoms dang dran pas bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par

byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de snying rje dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de dga' ba dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la mi byed pas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam pa shes pa mtha' yas so zhes rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ chung zad ma yod do zhes chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du

chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan te/ nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan 'di dag dang / tshad myed pa 'di dag dang / gzugs myed pa na yod pa 'di dag la nam mkha'i rnam pa dang / tshul dang / mtshan mas mnyam par gzhog cing / rnam pa ldang ba'i tshe yang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / 'dod pas dben/ sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam shes rab kyi pha rol tu sbyin pa stong zag brkya pa/ gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa rtog pa dang / rnam pa dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rnam par rtog pa myed pa/ rnam par dpyod pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas/ dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang snyoms su gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa/ bde ba la rnam par spyod pa btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal yang spangs shing yid bde ba dang / yid myi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas/ bde ba yang myed/ sdug bsngal yang myed pa/ btang snyoms dang dran pas bsam gtan

bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ mi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de snying rje dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de dga' ba dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa mi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ mi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la myi byed pas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam

mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam pa shes pa mtha' yas so zhes rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ cung zad ma yod de zhes chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan te/ nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan 'di dag dang / tshad myed pa 'di dag dang / gzugs myed pa na yod pa 'di dag la nam mkha'i rnam pa dang tshul dang / mtshan mas mnyam par gzhog cing rnam pa ldang ba'i tshe yang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / 'dod pas dben sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rnam par rtog pa myed pa/ rnam par dpyod pa myed pa/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang snyoms su gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa/ bde ba la rnam par

spyod pa btang snyoms pa'o/ /zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal yang spangs shing / yid bde ba dang / yid myi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas/ bde ba yang myed/ sdug bsngal yang myed pa/ btang snyoms dang dran pas/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing / rnam par spyod do/ /de snying rje dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi/ dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i/ phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing / rnam par spyod do/ /de dga' ba dang ldan pa'i sems/ rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ mi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi/ dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas/ gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu/ rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing / rnam par spyod do/ /de myi dmyigs

pa'i tshul gyis btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste mos par byas shing rnam pa spyod do/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la myi byed pas nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ chung zad ma yod do zhes chung zad med pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan te nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan 'di dag dang / tshad myed pa 'di dag dang / gzugs myed pa na yod pa 'di dag la nam mkha'i rnam pa dang / tshul dang / mtshan mas mnyam par gzhog cing rnam par ldang ba'i tshe yang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / 'dod pas
