myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam pa spyod do/ /de dga' ba dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa/ mi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam pa spyod do/ /de 'dod pas dben/ sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rnam par rtog pa myed pa/ rnam par dpyod pa myed pa/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang snyoms su gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la/ 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa bde ba la rnam par spyod pa btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs

te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal yang spangs shing / yid bde ba dang / yid mi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas/ bde ba yang myed/ sdug bsngal yang myed pa/ btang snyoms dang dran pas yongs su dag pa'i bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la myi byed pas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam pa shes pa mtha' yas so zhes/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ chung zad ma yod do zhes chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro bas/ nyon mongs pa rab tu spangs pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gzhan la rjod cing 'chad pa dang / ston cing 'grel la rnam par 'byed cing gsal bar byed de/ de dag gi ro dang / de dag gi skyon dang / 'byung ba yang tshul bzhin du ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba de dag

gis/ bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag la mnyam par gzhog cing rnam pa ldang yang 'di lta ste/ /nyan thos sam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi yang rung ste/ sems bskyed pa gzhan gyi go mi 'byed pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma nyams pa'o/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis rnam pa spyod pa'i tshe/ 'di snyam ste/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa zang par bya ba'i phyir chos bstan to/ /snyam du sems shing yid la bya ba de dag la bzod pa dang / mos pa dang / rtog pa dang / sems shing khong du chud par byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis rnam pa spyod pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad kyi don dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi phyir/ brtson 'grus nyam par mi byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la mnyam par gzhog cing rnam par ldang yang / nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar myi ltung ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i

bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ bsam gtan dang po'i yan lag dang / bsam gtan gnyis pa'i yan lag dang / bsam gtan gsum pa'i yan lag dang / bsam gtan bzhi pa'i yan lag dang / byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang / chung zad myed pa'i skye mched dang / 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched de dag myi rtag pa'i rnam pa dang / sdug bsngal ba'i rnam pa dang / bdag myed pa'i rnam pa dang / zhi ba'i rnam pa dang / stong pa'i rnam pa dang / mtshan ma myed pa'i rnam pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i rnam pa rab tu rtog kyang bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag myi dmyigs shing / de dag gis rlom sems myed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ rnam pa thams cad du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du yang dag par spong ba bzhi sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du dbang po lnga sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du stobs lnga sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du byang chub kyi yan lag bdun sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa bsgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams sgom pa dang /

rnam pa thams cad du bsam gtan rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du tshad myed pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du rnam pa thar pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du mngon par shes pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du ting nge 'dzin rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du gzungs kyi sgo rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du mi 'jigs pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du so so yang dag par rig pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du byams pa chen po sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du snying rje chen po sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du thams cad shes pa nyid sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid sgom pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhog cing / bdag gis sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab par bya'o zhes de la gzhol bar byed do/ /snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhog cing / sems can rnams la snying rje ba dang / snying brtse ba'i nyams su byed do/ /dga'

ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhog cing / bdag nyid kyis dgrol bar bya'o zhes sems can rnams la sems so/ /btang snyoms kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhog cing / sems can rnams kyi zag pa zad par bya ba la rab tu gzhol bar byed de/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad myed pa rnams la spyod pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa rnams kyi rnam pa dang / tshul dang / mtshan ma la mnyam par gzhog cing rnam par ldang yang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du bsngo ba ma gtogs par nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su mi sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad myed pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su mnyams pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis ma 'dres par rnam pa spyod cing / sa gnyis po nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar 'dod pa myi skyed/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mos shing dga' ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad myed pa rnams la spyod pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas/ myi dge ba'i chos rnams rab tu spang ba dang / dge ba'i chos phun sum tshogs par bya ba'i don du/ brtson 'grus myi gtong bas rnam par spyod pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad myed pa rnams la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug

pa 'di dag la yang mnyam par gzhog la/ bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i dbang gis kyang myi skye zhing/ /de dag gi ro myong bar byed pa yang myed la/ de dag gis 'phrogs par yang mi 'gyur ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad myed pa rnams la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag la yang mnyam par gzhog cing rnam par ldang la/ de dag la myi rtag pa'i rnam pa dang / sdug bsngal ba'i rnam pa dang / bdag myed pa'i rnam pa dang / zhi ba'i rnam pa dang / stong pa'i rnam pa dang / mtshan ma myed pa'i rnam pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i rnam par rab tu rtog kyang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi skyon myed par yang 'jug par myi byed pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad myed pa rnams la spyod pa'i/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ nang stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ phyi nang stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ chen po stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis

ma yin/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa shes kyag dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid shes kyang dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ chos thams cad la sems rnam par myi 'khrug cing mnyam par gzhag par shes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni rtag ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug pa dang / bde zhes bya bar shes pa myi 'jug /sdug bsngal zhes bya bar shes pa myi 'jug/ sdug bsngal zhes bya bar shes pa myi 'jug pa dang / bdag ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug bdag myed ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug pa dang / sdug ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug /myi sdug ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug pa dang / stong zhes bya bar shes pa myi 'jug myi stong zhes bya bar shes pa myi 'jug pa dang / mtshan ma yod ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug mtshan ma myed ces bya bar

shes pa myi 'jug pa dang / smon pa yod ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug smon pa myed ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni gang 'das pa'i dus la shes pa myi 'jug ma 'ongs pa'i dus la shes pa myi 'jug da ltar gyi dus la shes pa 'jug par myi byed de/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar gyi dus myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'di la 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar gyi dus myi shes pa yang med pa ste/ tshed dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ 'dod pa'i khams su shes pa 'jug par mi byed/ gzugs dang gzugs myed pa'i khams su shes pa 'jug pa myi byed la/ 'dod pa dang / gzugs dang gzugs myed pa'i khams myi shes pa yang myed pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di yang de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ 'jig rten pa'i chos la yang shes pa 'jug par myi byed 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa myed pa dang / 'dus byas kyi chos dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos la shes pa 'jug par myi byed kyang / 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos myi shes pa yang myed/ zag pa dang bcas pa dang zag pa myed pa dang / 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams kyang mi shes pa myed pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di yang de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po ci tsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' sems

dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po la gnas zhes bya/ gang pos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas kyang des sbyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ byang chub sems dpa' yang myi dmyigs/ len pa yang myi dmyigs/ yid la bya ba de dag kyang myi dmyigs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas kyang / des tshul khrims kyang myi dmyigs/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ byang chub sems dpa' yang myi dmyigs/ yid la bya ba de dag kyang myi dmyigs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas kyang / des bzod pa yang myi dmyigs/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ byang chub sems dpa' yang mi dmyigs/ yid la bya ba de dag kyang mi dmyigs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag

par gnas kyang / des brtson 'grus kyang myi dmyigs/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang mi dmyigs/ byang chub sems dpa' yang myi dmyigs/ yid la bya ba de dag kyang myi dmyigs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas shes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyipha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas byang / des bsam gtan yang myi dmyigs/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ byang chub sems dpa' yang myi dmyigs/ yid la bya ba de dag kyang myi dmyigs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas shes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas kyang / des dge ba'i chos kyang myi dmyigs shing / mi dge ba dang / 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa'i chos kyang myi dmyigs shing shes rab kyang myi dmyigs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ byang chub sems dpa' yang myi dmyigs/ yid la bya ba de dag kyang myi dmyigs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas shes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam

pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi nang stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid stong pa nyid sgom mo/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chen po stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chen po stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis don dam pa stong pa nyid sgom mo/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom rnam pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus byas stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam pa bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pasabasgom pa rnam pa bsgom pa'i don du/ de myi dmyigs

pa'i tshul gyis thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid sgom mo/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang bzhin stong pa nyid sgom mo/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed po'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa shar dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres

pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis yang dag par spong ba bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba bzhi sgom mo/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dang po lnga sgom mo/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stobs lnga bsgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems kyi yan lag bdun sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis bsam gtan bzhin sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs

pa'i tshul gyis tshad myed pa bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ /de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam par thar pa brgyad sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam pa bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mngon par shes pa rnams sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ting nge 'dzin rnams sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis gzungs kyi sgo rnams sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi

dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi 'jigs pa bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam pa bsgom pa'i don du/ de myi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam pa bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis snying rje chen po sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam pa bsgom pa'i don du/ de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad sgom mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par gnas zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' dmyigs su med pa'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni tha snyad tsam du zad do zhes bya par shes so/ /gzugs dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir gzugs zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /'du shes dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ 'du shes zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mying tsam du zad do/ /'du byed dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir 'du byed ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /myig dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ myig ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rna ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rna ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sna dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sna zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lce dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir lce zhes bya ba

'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lus dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ lus zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /yid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ /yid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /gzugs dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ gzugs zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sgra dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /dri dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ dri zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /ro dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ ro zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /reg dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ reg ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /chos dmyigs su med pa'i phyir/ chos zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ myig gi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sna'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ lce'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam

du zad do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung pa'i tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sa'i khams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sa'i khams zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /chu'i khams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ chu'i khams zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /mye'i khams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ mye'i khams zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rlung gi khams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rlung gi khams zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /nam mkha'i khams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ nam mkha'i

khams zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par shes pa'i khams zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /ma rig pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ ma rig pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /'du byed dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ 'du byed ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par shes ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /mying dang gzugs dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ mying dang gzugs shes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /skye mched drug dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ skye mched drug ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /reg pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ reg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sred pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sred pa zhes bya ba 'di ni myings tsam du zad do/ /len pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ len pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /srid pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ srid pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /skye ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ skye ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rga shi dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rga shi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'di

ni mying tsam du zad do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya pa 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /nang stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ nang stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /phyi stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ phyi stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ phyi nang stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /chen po stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ chen po stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ don dam pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su med pa'i phyir/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed

pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /ngo bo nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /dbang po rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ dbang po lnga zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /stobs rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ stobs lnga zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lam dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /bsam gtan rnams dmyigs su myed

pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /tshad myed pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ tshad myed pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rnam par thar pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par thar pa brgyad ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ mngon par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ gzungs kyi sgo zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /snying rje cen po dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ snying rje chen po zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams dmyigs su myed

pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /de bzhin nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ de bzhin nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /chos nyed dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ chos nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /chos kyi dbyings dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ chos kyi dbyings zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /chos kyi gnas nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ chos kyi gnas nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /chos skyon myed pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ chos skyon myed pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ yang dag pa'i mtha' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /byang chub dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sangs rgyas dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas shes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /zhes bya bar yang dag par shes te/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ theg pa chen po la yang dag par gnas zhes bya'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po dgu pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas snying po byang chub la 'dug gi bar du mngon par shes pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byas shing / sems can yongs su smyin par byed do/ /sangs

rgyas bcom ldan 'das la/ mchod pa dang / rim gror bya ba'i tshul gang la gang 'os pa de dag gis/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la rim gror bya ba dang / bkur stir bya ba dang / phu dud du bya ba dang / mchod pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag las kyang 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa 'di nyid kyi chos nyan to/ /de byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa de la gnas te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed/ sems can rnams yongs su smyin par byed kyang / de la sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi 'du shes kyang myi 'byung / sems can gyi 'du shes kyang myi 'byung / sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes kyang myi 'byung ngo / /de gnyis su myed pa'i sa la gnas shing / lus ji lta bus sems can rnams kyi don bya ba'i mthu yod pa de lta bu'i lus ched du bsams shing yongs su 'dzin te/ /de nam rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes thob par ma gyur gyi bar du/ theg pa de dang nam du yang myi 'bral te/ des rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes thob nas kyang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / myi dang myi ma yin pa dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis bskor bar myi nus pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu skor ro/ /de bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen

po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba byed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs su rjod pa mdzad do/ /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mos zhig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang / chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba byed do/ /zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs su rjod pa mdzad do/ /nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan brjod pa mdzad cing 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang / chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba byed do zhes/ grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs su rjod pa mdzad do/ /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa

'di zhes bya ba zhig /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba byed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs su rjod pa mdzad do/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba byed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs su rjod pa mdzad do/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba byed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs su rjod pa mdzad do/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa

nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba byed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs su rjod pa mdzad do/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba byed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs su rjod pa mdzad do/ /'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po/ bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba byed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs su rjod pa mdzad do/ /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi byem snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po/ bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba

byed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs su rjod pa mdzad do/ /de ltar na tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par gnas zhes bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das go cha chen po bgos so/ /go cha chen po bgos so zhes bgyi na/ bcom ldan 'das ji tsam gyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos zhes bgyi ba lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po'i go cha gyon cing 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha bgos/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha bgos/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha bgos/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha bgos/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha bgos/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha bgos/ nang stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ chos thams cad stong nyid kyi go cha bgos/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi go cha

bgos/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i go cha bgos/ yang dag par spong ba'i go cha bgos/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i go cha bgos/ dbang po'i go cha bgos/ stobs kyi go cha bgos/ byang chub kyi yan lag gi go cha bgos/ lam gyi go cha bgos/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i go cha bgos/ bsam gtan gyi go cha bgos/ tshad myed pa'i go cha bgos/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i go cha bgos/ rnam par thar pa'i go cha bgos/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i go cha bgos/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i go cha bgos/ mngon par shes pa'i go cha bgos/ ting nge 'dzin gyi go cha bgos/ gzungs kyi sgo'i go cha bgos/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyi go cha bgos/ myi 'jigs pa'i go cha bgos/ so so yang dag par rig pa'i go cha bgos/ snying rje chen po'i go cha bgos/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyi go cha bgos/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i go cha bgos nas/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang bas rgyas par bkang ste/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /nubaphyogasakyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma sned snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /

lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ 'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod do/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod do/ /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod do/ /nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod do/ /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod do/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod do/ shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod do/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅggā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod do/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod do/ /'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod do/ /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod do/ /des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ sems can dmyal ba'i mye'i phung po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad myed par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i

sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ byol song gi skye gnas kyi sems can rnams kyi byol song gi skye gnas kyi sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyang zhi bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe byol song gi skye gnas kyi sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des/ byol song gi skye gnas de dag gnas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag byol song gi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par langs nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sems can rnams kyi gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad zhi bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag gshin rje'i

'jig rten de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can dmyal ba'i mye'i phung po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad myed par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des/ sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can dmyal ba'i mye'i phung po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad myed par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des/ sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgū'i klung gii bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can dmyal ba'i mye'i phung po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad myed par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom
