dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nang gi lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ lus 'di la sa'i khams kyang yod do/ /chu'i khams dang / mye'i khams dang / rlung gi khams kyang yod do zhes bya bar khams kyi rnam par yang dag ci lta ba bzhin du rab tu rtog ste/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ ba lang gi shen pa'am/ ba lang gi shen pa'i mchan bu mkhas pas mtshon rnon po thogs te/ ba lang bsad cing bag bzhir gshags te/ de ltar so sor phye nas/'greng ngam 'dug ste/ de la rab tu rtog pa de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yang / lus 'di la sa'i khams kyang yod do/ /chu'i khams dang / mye'i khams dang / rlung gi khams kyang yod do zhes bya bar khams kyi rnam pa yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtog ste/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / 'greng ngam 'dug ste/ nang gi lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang / yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ lus 'di nyid la rkang pa'i mthil yan chad/ skra dang glad pa man chad du/ sen mo dang / spu dang pags pa yan chad du myi gtsang ba sna tshogs kyis gang bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtog ste/ lus 'di la skra dang / spu dang

sen mo dang / bags pa dang / glog pa dang / sha dang chub dang / khrag dang / rus pa dang / rkang dang / snying dang mkhal ma dang mchin pa dang / glo ba dang / mtsher pa dang / long ka dang / rgyu ma dang / gnye ma dang / nang grol dang / gcin dang / phyi sa dang / mchi ma dang / rngul dang / tshil dang / snabs dang / ngar snabs dang / rnag dang / mkhris pa dang / bad kan dang / chu ser dang / kha chu dang / dri ma dang / glad pa dang / glad rgyas dang / rngu ma dang / rna spabs dag kyang yod do/ /zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu rtog ste/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ chun pa'i sgye snod til dang / yungs kar dang / sran chung dang / bal sran dang / nas dang / gro dang / 'bras dang / 'bru sna tshogs kyis gang ba myig dang ldan pa'i myi zhig gis phye ste/ bltas na/ 'di ni til lo/ /'di ni yungs kar ro/ /'di ni sran chung ngo / /'di ni bal sran no/ /'di ni nas so/ /'di ni gro'o/ /'di ni 'bras so/ /'di dag ni de ma yin pa'i 'bru gzhan no zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang lus 'di nyid la rkang pa'i mthil yan chad/ skra dang spyi bo man chad sen mo dang / spu dang / pags pa yan chad du myi gtsang ba sna tshogs kyis gang bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtog ste/ lus 'di la skra dang / spu dang / sen mo dang / pags pa dang / glog pa dang / sha dang / chu ba dang / khrag dang / rus pa dang / rkang dang / snying dang / mkhal ma dang / mchin pa dang / glo ba dang / mtsher pa dang / long ka dang / rgyu ma dang / gnye ma dang / nang grol dang / gcin dang / phyi sa dang / mchi ma dang / rngul dang / tshil dang / snabs dang / ngar snabs dang / rnag dang / mkhris pa dang / bad kan dang / chu ser dang / kha chu dang / dri ma dang / glad pa dang / glad rgyas dang / rngu ma dang / rna spabs dag kyang yod do zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu rtog go/ //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu gsum pa/

rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nang gi lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nam dur khrod na yod pa'i gzugs sna tshogs/ dur khrod du bor ba/ ro'i mal du bsnyal ba/ shi nas zhag gcig lon pa'am/ shi nas zhag gnyis lon pa'am/ shi nas zhag gsum lon pa'am/ shi nas zhag bzhi lon pa'am/ shi nas zhag lnga lon pa'am/ rnam par bam pa'am/ rnam par sngos pa'am/ rnam par rnags pa'am/ rnam par zos pa'am/ rnam par 'thor ba mthong na/ de lus 'di nyid kyi tshul yang de dang sbyor te/ lus 'di yang 'di lta bu'i chos can no/ /'di lta bu'i rang bzhin can te/ chos nyid 'di las ma 'das pa'o/ /zhes bya bar nye bar sbyor ro/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ phyi'i lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nam dur khrod du bor ba'i ro/ shi nas zhag drug lon pa'am/ shi nas zhag bdun lon pa/ bya rog gam/ khwa'am/ 'ol pa'am/ bya rgod dam/ spyang ki'am/ wa'am khyi'am/ de ma yin pa'i srog chags kyi rigs sna tshogs kyis bza' ba mthong ba de'i tshe/ de lus 'di nyid kyi tshul yang de dang sbyor te/ lus 'di nyid kyang de lta bu'i chos can/

de lta bu'i rang bzhin can te/ chos nyid de lta bu las ma 'das so/ /zhes bya bar nye bar rtog go/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ phyi'i lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nam dur khrod du bor ba'i ro rnam par zos pa/ myi gtsang ba rnags pa/ sungs pa mthong ba de'i tshe/ lus 'di nyid kyi tshul yang de dang sbyor te/ lus 'di yang / 'di lta bu'i chos can/ 'di lta bu'i rang bzhin can/ 'di lta bu'i chos nyid las ma 'das pa'o zhes bya bar nye bar rtog go/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ phyi'i lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nam dur khrod kyi rus pa/ keng rus shar ri dang / khrag ra ri chags pa/ rgyus pas brang breng du 'brel ba mthong ba de'i tshe/ de lus 'di nyid kyi tshul yang de dang sbyor te/ lus 'di yang 'di lta bu'i chos can/ 'di lta bu'i rang bzhin can te/ 'di lta bu'i chos nyid las ma 'das pa'o/ /zhes bya bar nye bar rtog go/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ phyi'i lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags

sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nam dur khrod kyi rus pa keng rus sha dang khrag myed pa/ rgyus pa'i gzungs myed pa dung gi mdog ltar gyur pa mthong ba de'i tshe/ de lus 'di nyid kyi tshul yang de dang nye bar sbyor te/ lus 'di nyid kyang 'di lta bu'i chos can 'di lta bu'i rang bzhin can te/ 'di lta bu'i chos nyid las ma 'das pa'o zhes bya bar nye bar rtog go/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ phyi'i lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid mi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nam dur khrod kyi rus pa keng rus gzungs myed pa gyes pa dung gi mdog ltar gyur pa/ sa la rnam par 'thor ba mthong ba de'i tshe/ de lus 'di nyid kyi tshul yang de dang nye bar sbyor te/ lus 'di yang 'di lta bu'i chos can 'di lta bu'i rang bzhin can te/ 'di lta bu'i chos nyid las ma 'das pa'o zhes bya bar nye bar rtog go/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ phyi'i lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang / yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nam dur

khrod kyi rus pas la phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su rnam par 'thor ba/ rkang pa'i rus pa rnams kyang gzhan du 'thor/ byin pa'i rus pa rnams kyang gzhan du 'thor/ brla'i rus pa rnams kyang gzhan du 'thor/ dpyi'i rus pa rnams kyang gzhan du 'thor/ tshigs pa'i rus pa rnams kyang gzhan du 'thor/ rtsib ma'i rus pa rnams kyang gzhan du 'thor/ mjing pa'i rus pa rnams kyang gzhan du 'thor/ mgo'i rus pa rnams kyang gzhan du 'thor ba mthong na/ de lus 'di nyid kyi tshul yang de dang sbyor te/ lus 'di yang 'di lta bu'i chos can/ 'di lta bu'i rang bzhin can te 'di lta bu'i chos nyid las ma 'das pa'o zhes bya bar nye bar rtog go/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ phyi'i lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nam dur khrod kyi rus pa lo du ma lon pa/ rlung dang nyi mas gdungs pa/ dung gi mdog ltar gyur pa mthong ba de'i tshe/ de lus 'di nyid kyang de dang nye bar sbyor te/ lus 'di yang 'di lta bu'i chos can 'di lta bu'i rang bzhin can te/ 'di lta bu'i chos nyid las ma 'das pa'o zhes bya bar nye bar rtog go /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ phyi'i lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab

kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nam dur khrod kyi rus pa lo du ma khon pa rab rib snang ba/ sngon por gyur pa thi ba'i mdog ltar gyur pa/ zegs pa brul ba sa'i rdul dang 'gran 'gren du gyur pa mthong ba de'i tshe/ de lus 'di nyid kyi tshul yang de dang sbyor te/ lus 'di nyid kyang 'di lta bu'i chos can no/ /'di lta bu'i rang bzhin can te/ 'di lta bu'i chos nyid las ma 'das pa'o zhes bya bar nye bar rtog go/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nang gi lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /phyi'i lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /phyi nang gi lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /nang gi tshor ba la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis tshor ba'i rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /phyi'i tshor ba la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis tshor ba'i rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /phyi nang gi tshor ba la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis tshor ba'i rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin

dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /nang gi sems la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sems kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /phyi'i sems la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sems kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /phyi nang gi sems la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sems kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid mi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /nang gi chos la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /phyi'i chos la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /phyi nang gi chos la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /rab 'byor 'di yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ 'di ltar yang dag par spong ba bzhi ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sdig to myi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa'i rnams myi bskyed pa'i phyir/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mos bskyed cing rtsol lo/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems kyi mthu skyed do/ /yang dag par smon lam 'debs so/ /sdig to myi dge ba'i chos skyes pa'i rnams spangs pa'i phyir de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mos pa skyed cing rtsol lo/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems kyi mthu skyed do/ /yang dag par smon lam 'debs so/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa'i rnams bskyed pa'i phyir/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mos pa skyed cing rtsol lo/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems kyi mthu skyed do/ /yang dag par smon lam 'debs so/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa'i rnams gnas pa dang / phyir zhing bsgom pa dang / nyams par myi 'gyur ba dang / yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mos pa skyed cing rtsol lo/ /brtson 'grus brtsom mo/ /sems kyi mthu skyed do/ /yang dag par smon lam 'debs te/ rab 'byor 'di yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mos pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa sgom mo/ /brtson 'grus kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dben pa la gnas pa 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa sgom mo/ /sems kyi ting

nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa sgom mo/ /dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa sgom ste/ rab 'byor 'di yang de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'di ltar dbang po lnga ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ dad pa'i dbang po dang / brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang / dran pa'i dbang po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang / shes rab kyi dbang po ste/ rab 'byor 'di yang de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'di ltar stobs lnga ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ dad pa'i stobs dang / brtson 'grus kyi stobs dang / dran pa'i stobs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang / shes rab kyi stobs te/ rab 'byor 'di yang de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dag pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'di ltar byang chub kyi yan lag bdun te/ bdun gang zhe na/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dgra byang chub kyi yan lag dang / brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan

lag go/ /de la dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa byed do/ /de la chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa byed do/ /de la brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa byed do/ /de la dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa byed do/ /de la shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa byed do/ /de la ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa byed do/ /de la btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa la gnas pa 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa byed do/ /rab 'byor 'di yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ 'di ltar 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ste/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa gang zhe na/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtog pa dang / yang dag pa'i ngag dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang / yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la yang dag pa'i lta ba gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod

chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa byed do/ /de la yang dag pa'i rtog pa gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa byed do/ /yang dag pa'i ngag gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa'i ngag dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa byed do/ /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa byed do/ /yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa byed do/ /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dben pa la

gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa byed do/ /yang dag pa'i dran pa gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa'i dran pa dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa byed do/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dben pa la gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa/ 'gog pa la gnas pa/ rnam par spong bas yongs su grub pa de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa byed de/ rab 'byor 'di yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin gsum ste/ gsum gang zhe na/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / mtshan ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ chos thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid du rtog pa'i tshe/ sems gnas pa stong pa nyid rnam par thar pa'i sgo ste 'di ni stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ces bya'o/ /de la mtshan ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ chos thams cad mtshan ma myed par rtog pa'i tshe/ sems gnas pa mtshan ma myed pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo ste/ 'di ni mtshan ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya'o/ /de la smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ chos thams cad mngon par 'du bya ba myed do/ /zhes mngon par 'du myi byed pa'i tshe/ sems gnas pa

smon pa myed pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo ste/ 'di ni smon pa myed pa'i tiṃng nge 'dzin ces bya ste/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo de dag la zhum pa myed par dran par bya ste/ rab 'byor 'di yang de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'di ltar ye shes bcu gcig ste/ bcu gcig gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal shes pa dang / kun 'byung ba shes pa dang / 'gog pa shes pa dang / lam shes pa dang / zad pa shes pa dang / myi skye ba shes pa dang / chos shes pa dang / rjes su rtogs pa shes pa dang / kun rdzob shes pa dang / 'dris pa shes pa dang / sgra ji bzhin shes pa'o/ /de la sdug bsngal shes pa gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal myi skye bar shes pa'o/ /de la kun 'byung ba shes pa gang zhe na/ kun 'byung ba spang bar shes pa'o/ /de la 'gog pa shes pa gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal 'gog par shes pa'o/ /de la lam shes pa gang zhe na/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa shes pa'o/ /de la zad pa shes pa gang zhe na/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug zad par shes pa'o/ /de la myi skye ba shes pa gang zhe na/ srid pa'i rgyud skye ba myed par shes pa'o/ /de la chos shes pa gang zhe na/ phung po lnga sgyu mar yongs su rtogs shing shes pa'o/ /de la rjes su rtogs pa'i shes pa gang zhe na/ myig myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / rna ba myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / sna myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / lce myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / lus myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang yid myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / gzugs myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / sgra myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / dri myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / ro myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / reg myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / chos myi rtag

ces bya bar shes pa dang / myig gi khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / gzugs kyi khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / myig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / rna ba'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / sgra'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / sna'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / dri'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / lce'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / ro'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / lus kyi khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / reg bya'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / yid kyi khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / chos kyi khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / sa'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / chu'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / mye'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / rlung gi khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / nam mkha'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / ma rig pa myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / 'du byed myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / rnam par shes pa myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / mying dang gzugs myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / skye mched drug myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / reg pa myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / tshor ba myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / sred pa myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / len pa myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / srid pa myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang /

skye ba myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa dang / rga shi myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa'o/ /de la kun rdzob shes pa gang zhe na/ sems can gzhan dang gang zag gzhan gyi sems sems kyis shes pa'o/ /de la 'dris pa shes pa gang zhe na/ gang gis lam shes pa dang / yongs su byang ba shes pa'o/ /de la sgra ci bzhin shes pa gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes te/ rab 'byor 'di yang myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ 'di ltar dbang po gsum ste/ gsum gang zhe na/ yongs su ma shes pa yongs su shes par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba'i dbang po dang / yongs su shes pa'i dbang po dang / yongs su shes pas rtogs pa'i dbang po'o/ /de la yongs su ma shes pa yongs su shes par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba'i dbang po gang zhe na/ slob pa'i gang zag mngon par rtogs par ma gyur pa rnams kyi dad pa'i dbang po dang / brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang / dran pa'i dbang po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang / shes rab kyi dbang po yongs su snang bar ma gyur pa 'di ni yongs su ma shes pa yongs su shes par bya'o zhes bya ba'i dbang po'o/ /de la yongs su shes pa'i dbang po gang zhe na/ gang zag slob pa yongs su shes par gyur pa rnams kyi dad pa'i dbang po dang / brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang / dran pa'i dbang po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang / shes rab kyi dbang po ste 'di ni yongs su shes pa'i dbang po zhes bya'o/ /de la yongs su shes pas rtogs pa'i dbang po gang zhe na/ gang zag myi slob pa dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dad pa'i dbang po dang / brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang / dran pa'i dbang po dang / ting nge

'dzin gyi dbang po dang / shes rab kyi dbang po ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni yongs su shes pas rtogs pa'i dbang po zhes bya ste/ rab 'byor 'di yang myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin gsum ste/ gsum gang zhe na/ rtog pa dang bcas shing dpyod pa dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rtog pa myed la dpyod pa tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / rtog pa myed cing dpyod pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la rtog pa dang bcas dpyod pa dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'dod pas dben/ sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa rtog pa dang bcas pa dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs shing gnas te/ 'di ni rtog pa dang bcas shing dpyod pa dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la rtog pa myed la dpyod pa tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ bsam gtan dang po dang / bsam gtan gnyis pa'i bar te/ 'di ni rtog pa myed la dpyod pa tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin ces bya'o/ /de la rtog pa myed cing dpyod pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ bsam gtan gnyis pa dang / bsam gtan gsum pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi pa dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa dang / cung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa dang / 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa dang / 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'o/ /'di ni myi rtag myi dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ste/ rab 'byor 'di yang myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems

dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ 'di ltar rjes su dran pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang / chos rjes su dran pa dang / dge 'dun rjes su dran pa dang / tshul khrims rjes su dran pa dang / gtong ba rjes su dran pa dang / lha rjes su dran pa dang / dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba rjes su dran pa dang / skyo ba rjes su dran pa dang / 'chi ba rjes su dran pa dang / lus kyi rnam pa rjes su dran pa ste/ rab 'byor 'di yang de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'di lta ste/ bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ste/ de la bsam gtan bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ 'dod pas dben sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas/ nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rtog pa myed pa dpyod pa myed pa/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas/ dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang snyoms la gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la/ 'phags pa rnams kyis de la

dran pa dang ldan pa/ bde ba la rnam par spyod pa btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs sdug bsngal yang spangs shing / yid bde ba dang yid myi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas/ bde ba yang myed sdug bsngal yang myed pa btang snyoms dang dran pas yongs su dag pa'i bsam gtan bzhi pa la myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nye bar bsgrubs shing gnas te/ de dag ni bsam gtan bzhi'o/ /de la tshad myed pa bzhi gang zhe na 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de snying rje dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de dga' ba dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed

pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ ltod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam par spyod de/ de dag ni tshad myed pa bzhi'o/ /de la gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la myi byed pas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ cung zad ma yod do zhes cung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du cung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dag ni gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi'o/ /de la rnam par thar pa brgyad gang zhe na/ gzugs can gyis gzugs rnams mthong ba 'di ni rnam par thar pa dang po'o/ /nang gzugs myed pa'i 'du shes dang ldan pas/ phyi rol gyi gzugs rnams mthong ba 'di ni rnam par thar pa gnyis pa'o/ /bzang bar mos pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa gsum pa'o/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du

shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la myi byed pas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes te/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ chung zad ma yod do zhes chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa'i bar du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nye bar bsgrubs shing gnas te de dag ni rnam par thar pa brgyad do/ /de la mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ 'dod pas dben/ sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rtog pa myed pa/ dpyod pa myed pa/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas dran pa dang ldan zhing / shes bzhin du

btang snyoms su gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa/ bde ba la rnam par spyod pa btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal yang spangs shing / yid bde ba dang yid myi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas/ bde ba yang myed sdug bsngal yang myed pa/ btang snyoms dang dran pas yongs su dag pa bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la myi byed pas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes te/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ chung zad ma yod do zhes chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa'i bar du myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nye bar bsgrubs shing gnas te/ de dag ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ rab 'byor

'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gnas la'ang gnas su yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /gnas ma yin pa la'ang gnas ma yin par yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i las dang / las yongs su len pa'i rnam par smyin pa/ gnas kyi rnam pa dang / rgyu'i rnam par yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /'jig rten ni khams sna tshogs can te/ 'jig rten ni khams du ma pa'o zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /sems can gzhan dang / gang zag gzhan gyi mos pa sna tshogs dang / mos pa du ma yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /sems can gzhan dang gang zag gzhan gyi dbang po rab dang / tham shes par bya ba yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /kun tu 'gro ba'i lam yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba rnam par dgod pa yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /de rnam pa du mar sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran te/ tshe rabs gcig kyang rjes su dran pa nas/ tshe rabs brgya dang / tshe rabs stong dang / tshe rabs brgya stong dang / tshe rabs bye ba dang / tshe rabs bye ba brgya dang / tshe rabs bye ba stong dang / tshe rabs bye ba brgya phrag stong dang / tshe rabs bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong dag kyang rjes su dran no/ /bskal pa gcig kyang rjes su dran pa nas/ bskal pa brgya dang / bskal pa stong dang / bskal pa brgya phrag stong nas/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong gi bar dag kyang rjes su dran te/ bdag ni 'di lta

bu zhig na 'dug 'dug go/ /mying ni 'di zhes bya'o/ /rigs ni 'di zhes bya'o/ /rus ni 'di zhes bya'o/ /zas ni 'di za za'o/ /yun ni 'di srid cig tu gnas gnas so/ /tshe'i mtha' ni 'di tsam zhig tu gyur te/ de ltar bdag de nas shi 'phos nas che ge mo zhig du skyes so zhes bya ba nas/ de nas shi 'phos nas kyang 'dir skyes so zhes bya bar rnam pa dang bcas/ sa mal dang bcas/ gtan tshigs dang bcas par rnam pa du mar sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran no/ /lha'i myig rnam par dag pa myi'i las 'das pas/ sems can 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba dag kyang mthong ngo / /kha dog sdug pa dang / kha dog myi sdug pa dang / bzang ba dang / ngan pa dang / bde 'gro na 'khod pa dang / ngan song na 'khod pa dang / las ji lta ba bzhin du nye bar 'dong ba'i sems can rnams rab tu shes te/ sems can 'di dag ni lus kyis ngan du spyod pa dang ldan pa dag gis ngan du spyod pa dang ldan pa/ yid kyis ngan du spyod pa dang ldan pa/ 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa/ log par lta bdag ste/ de'i rgyu de'i rkyen gyis lus zhig nas ngan song log par ltung ba sems can dmyal bar skye'o/ /sems can 'di dag ni lus kyis legs par spyod pa dang ldan pa/ ngag gis legs par spyod pa dang ldan pa/ yid kyis legs par spyod pa dang ldan pa/ 'phags pa la skur pa myi 'debs pa/ yang dag par lta ba dag ste/ de'i rgyu de'i rkyen gyis lus zhig nas/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi lha'i nang du skye'o zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /zag pa rnams zad pa'i phyir sems rnam par grol ba dang / shes rab rnam par grol ba zag pa myed pa/ rang gis mngon par shes pas mngon du byas te/ nye bar bsgrubs shing rnam par spyod do/ /bdag gi skye ba ni zad do/ /bdag gis tshangs par spyod pa ni spyad do/ /bya ba ni byas so/ /rnam pa 'di lta bu gzhan ni myed

do zhes bya bar rab tu shes te/ rab 'byor de yang de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ 'di ltar myi 'jigs pa bzhi ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ bdag gis yang dag par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so zhes dam bcas na/ de la chos 'di rnams mngon par sangs ma rgyas so zhes bya bar bdag la dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ gzhan su yang rung ste/ 'jig rten na chos dang ldan par rgol bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i rgyu yang / yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ste/ rgyu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong bas/ de la bdag bde ba thob pa dang / bag tsha ba myed pa thob pa dang / myi 'jigs pa thob par rnam par spyod de/ khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas su dam bca'o/ /'khor kyi nang du seng ge'i sgra bsgrag go/ /tshangs pa'i 'khor lo 'jig rten na dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha 'am bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ gzhan sus kyang rung ste/ chos dang ldan par bskor bar myi nus pa/ bdag gis rab tu bskor bar bya'o/ /bdag zag pa zad do zhes dam bcas na/ de la zag pa 'di rnams yongs su zad par ma gyur to/ /zhes bya bar ba dag la dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ gzhan su yang rung ste/ 'jig rten na chos dang ldan par rgol bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i rgyu yang yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ste/ rgyu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong bas/ de la bdag bde ba thob pa dang / bag tsha ba myed pa thob pa dang / myi 'jigs pa thob par rnam par spyod de/ khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas su dam bca'o/ /'khor gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra bsgrag go /tshangs pa'i 'khor lo 'jig rten na dge

sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ gzhan sus kyang rung ste/ chos dang ldan par bskor bar myi nus pa bdag gis rab tu bskor bar bya'o/ /gang yang bdag gis bar chad kyi chos su bstan pa de dag la bsten na/ bar chad kyi chos su myi 'gyur ba de lta bu'i gnas myed de/ de'i phyir bdag la dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ gzhan su yang rung ste/ 'jig rten na chos dang ldan par rgol bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba'i rgyu yang yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ste/ rgyu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong bas/ de la bdag bde ba thob pa dang / bag tsha ba myed pa thob pa dang / myi 'jigs pa thob par rnam par spyod de/ khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas su dam bca'o/ /'khor kyi nang du seng ge'i sgra bsgrag go/ /tshangs pa'i 'khor lo 'jig rten na dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ gzhan sus kyang rung ste/ chos dang ldan par bskor bar myi nus pa bdag gis rab tu bskor bar bya'o/ /gang yang bdag gis lam 'phags pa'i 'byung ba rtogs par 'gyur ba de byed pa'i sdug bsngal yang dag par zad par 'gyur bar bstan pa de dag la nan tan byas na/ sdug bsngal yang dag par zad par 'gyur bar myi 'byung ngo zhes bya ba de lta bu'i gnas myed de/ de'i phyir bdag la dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ gzhan su yang rung ste/ 'jig rten na chos dang ldan par rgol bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i rgyu yang yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ste rgyu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong bas/ de la bdag bde ba thob pa dang / bag tsha ba myed pa thob pa dang / myi 'jigs pa thob par rnam par spyod de/ khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas su dam bca'o/ /'khor kyi nang du seng ge'i sgra bsgrag

go/ /tshangs pa'i 'khor lo 'jig rten na dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ gzhan sus kyang rung ste/ chos dang ldan par bskor bar myi nus pa bdag gis rab tu bskor bar bya'o zhes bya ba ste/ rab 'byor 'di yang de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ 'di ltar so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ don so so yang dag par rig pa dang / chos so so yang dag par rig pa dang / nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa dang / spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa ste/ rab 'byor 'di yang de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad de/ bcwo brgyad gang zhe na/ gang gis nam la de bzhin gshegs pa bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas pa dang / gang gis nam la lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten/ bdud dang bcas pa/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang / dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu dang / lha dang / myi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa sdug bsngal zad par 'gyur ba'i lam gyis rjes su bstan te/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa de'i bar du de bzhin gshegs pa la 'khrul pa myi mnga'o/ /ca co myi mnga'o/ /dgongs pa nyams pa myi mnga'o/ /'du shes sna tshogs myi mnga'o/ /thugs mnyam par ma bzhag pa myi mnga'o/ /ma brtags pa'i btang snyoms myi mnga'o/ mos pa yongs su nyams pa myi mnga'o/ /brtson 'grus yongs su nyams pa myi mnga'o/ /

dgongs pa yongs su nyams pa myi mnga'o/ /ting nge 'dzin yongs su nyams pa myi mnga'o/ /shes rab yongs su nyams pa myi mnga'o/ /rnam par grol ba yongs su nyams pa myi mnga'o/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa yongs su nyams pa myi mnga'o/ /sku'i phrin las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro ba ste/ ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ngo / /gsung gi phrin las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro ba ste/ ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ngo / /thugs kyi phrin las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro ba ste/ ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ngo / /'das pa'i dus la ma thogs ma chags pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus la ma thogs ma chags pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /da ltar byung ba'i dus lam thogs ma chags pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug ste/ rab 'byor 'di yang de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ 'di ltar gzungs kyi sgo rnams te yi ge mnyam pa nyid dang / brjod pa mnyam pa nyid dang / yi ge'i sgo dang / yi ge la 'jug pa ste/ de la yi ge'i sgo dang / yi ge la 'jug pa gang zhe na/ a zhes bya ba ni ma skyes pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ra zhes bya ba ni rdul dang bral ba'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /pa zhes bya ba ni don dam pa ston pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /tsa zhes bya ba ni 'chi 'pho dang skye ba myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad 'chi 'pho dang skye ba myed pas/ chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /na zhes bya ba ni mying dang bral zhing mying gi rang bzhin ma thob ma stor bas chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /la zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten las 'das shing srid pa'i 'khri shing dang / rgyu dang rkyen

yang dag par bcom pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /da zhes bya ba ni dul ba dang dul ba'i gnas su yongs su nges pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ba zhes bya ba ni bcings pa dang bral ba'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ṭa zhes bya ba ni dkrugs ma dang bral ba'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /sa zhes bya ba ni chags pa myi dmyigs pas chags par myi 'gyur/ 'ching bar myi 'gyur ba'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ba zhes bya ba ni ngag gi lam dang sgra yang dag par chad pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ta zhes bya ba ni de bzhin nyid las ma g.yos pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ya zhes bya ba ni yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /sta zhes bya ba ni khengs pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ka zhes bya ba ni byed pa po myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /sa zhes bya ba ni mnyam pa nyid du myi dmyigs pas mnyam pa nyid las myi 'da' ba'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ma zhes bya ba ni bdag gir bya ba myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ga zhes bya ba ni 'gro ba myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /tha zhes bya ba ni gnas myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /dza zhes bya ba ni skye ba myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /shwa zhes bya ba ni dbugs dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /dha zhes bya ba ni chos kyi dbyings dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /sha zhes bya ba ni zhi gnas dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /kha zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pas dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /kṣa zhes bya ba ni zad pa myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /sta zhes bya ba ni bstod pa myi

dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /dzña zhes bya ba ni ye shes dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /rta zhes bya ba ni nyon mongs pa myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ha zhes bya ba ni rgyu myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /bha zhes bya ba ni 'jigs pa myed pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /tsha zhes bya ba ni mdog myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /sma zhes bya ba ni dran pa myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /hwa zhes bya ba ni bod pa myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /tas zhes bya ba ni mos pa myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /gha zhes bya ba ni stug po myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /tha zhes bya ba ni bsgrub pa myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ṇa zhes bya ba ni nyon mongs pa myed pas gang yang 'gro ba myed cing 'ong ba myed de/ gnas pa myed cing 'dug pa myed la nyal bar 'gyur ba myed pas rnam par myi rtog pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /pha zhes bya ba ni 'bras bu dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ska zhes bya ba ni phung po dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /yas zhes bya ba ni myi bde ba myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /tsa zhes bya ba ni spyod pa myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ṭa zhes bya ba ni sdug bsngal myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ḍha zhes bya ba ni g.yog pa myi dmyigs pas mtha' thug par gnas par 'chi 'pho myed cing skye ba myed pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo ste/ de yan chad yi ge'i tha snyad myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gang la yang gang gis tha snyad du bya ba dang / gang gis brjod pa dang / gang gis bstan pa dang / gang bri ba dang / gang snang ba dang / gang klag par bya ba de

lta bu'i mying gang yang myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ nam mkha' bzhin du chos thams cad khong du chud par bya ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni gzungs kyi sgo la 'jug pa a las stsogs pa'i yi ge bstan pa la 'jug pa'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gis a las stsogs pa'i yi ge la mkhas par bya ba 'di yongs su shes na/ de ni sgra gang la yang chags par myi 'gyur te/ thams cad chos nyid kyis yang dag par sgrub par 'gyur zhing sgra shes par bya ba la mkhas pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' gang gis a las stsogs pa'i yi ge la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya 'di dang / a las stsogs pa'i yi ge la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya'i tshig 'di dag thos te/ thos nas kyang 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed cing gzhan la yang tshul dang ldan pa'i blos ston na/ de la legs pa nyi shu yod par shes par bya'o/ /nyi shu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dran pa dang ldan/ blo gros dang ldan/ rtogs pa dang ldan/ blo dang ldan/ dga' ba dang ldan/ngo tsha shes pa dang ldan/ spobs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / gzungs kyi sgo 'di yang nyon mongs pa myed par thob cing the tsom myed par 'gyur la/ gzhan las ngag snyan pa thos kyang chags par 'gyur ba myed cing zhe gcod pa'i tshig thos kyang khong khro bar myi 'gyur bas/ mtho ba myed cing dma' ba myed de/ tshul bzhin du gnas par 'gyur ba dang / sgra la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / phung po la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / khams la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / skye mched la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / bden pa la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la mkhas par 'gyur ba ste/ rgyu la mkhas shing rkyen la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / chos nyid la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / dbang po rab dang tha ma

shes par bya ba la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / 'chi 'pho dang skye ba shes par bya ba la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / lha'i rna ba'i shes pa la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / pha rol gyi sems shes par bya ba la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa shes par bya ba la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam pa shes par bya ba la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / zag pa zad pa shes par bya ba la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / gnas dang gnas ma yin pa bstan pa shes par bya ba'i mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / 'gro ba la mkhas shing ldog pa la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / spyod lam la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / khrel yod pa dang ngo tsha shes pa la mkhas pa yang 'thob par 'gyur te/ rab 'byor gzungs kyi sgo a las stsogs pa'i yi ge la 'jug pa 'di yang de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las le'u dgu'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu bzhi pa/ rab 'byor gang yang khyod 'di skad du ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa yin zhes zer ba ni/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod cing sa nas sar 'phar te/ rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod cing / sa nas sar 'phar ba yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad 'pho ba myed pas/ chos gang yang 'ong ba myed cing 'gro ba myed de/ 'pho ba'am nye bar 'pho ba myed do/ /'on kyang chos thams cad kyis

gang yin pa de la rlom sems su byed pa'am/ sems pa myed de sa yongs su sbyong ba yang myi byed pa ma yin la/ sa de yang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sa yongs su sbyang ba gang zhe na/ rab 'byor sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos yongs su sbyong ba bcu po 'di dag bya ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lhag pa'i bsam pa las stsogs pa yongs su sbyang ba dang / mtshan ma myi dmyigs pa'i phyir phan pa'i dngos po yongs su sbyang zhing sems can myi dmyigs pa'i phyir/ sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid yongs su sbyang ba dang / sbyin pa dang / gtong ba dang / len pa myi dmyigs pa'i phyir gtong ba yongs su sbyang ba dang / des rlom sems su myi bya ba'i phyir/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bstan pa yongs su sbyang ba dang / chos thams cad myi dmyigs pa'i phyir chos btsal ba yongs su sbyang ba dang / khyim myi dmyigs pa'i phyir yang dang yang 'byung ba yongs su sbyang ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po'i mtshan ma myi dmyigs pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi sku la mas pa yongs su sbyang ba dang / chos kyi rnam pa myi dmyigs pa'i phyir/ chos rnam par dbye ba yongs su sbyang ba dang / chos kyi yang dag pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i phyir/ nga rgyal dang khengs pa bstsal ba yongs su sbyang ba dang / tshig myi dmyigs pa'i phyir bden pa'i tshig yongs su sbyang ba ste/ rab 'byor yongs su sbyang ba bcu po de dag ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa dang po la gnas pas bya ba dag go/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa gnyis pa la gnas pas chos brgyad po 'di dag yang dang yang du yid la bya ste/ de la nan tan du bya'o/ /brgyad gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ tshul khrims yongs su dag pa

dang / byas pa shes shing drin du gzo ba dang / bzod pa'i mthu la gnas pa dang / rab tu dga' zhing spro ba myong bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su myi gtang ba dang / snying rje chen po mngon du bya ba dang / bla ma bsnyen bkur zhing dad pas gus par bya ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la brtson zhing tshol ba ste/ rab 'byor chos brgyad po de dag ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa gnyis pa la gnas pas/ yang dang yang du yid la bya zhing / de dag la nan tan du bya ba dag go/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos gsum pa la gnas pas chos lnga la gnas par bya ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mang du thos pas myi ngoms shing de la yang yi ge la mngon par ma zhen pa dang / zang zing myed par chos kyi sbyin pa rnam par 'byed cing des kyang rlom sems su myi 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba skyed cing / yongs su sngo yang des rlom sems su myi 'gyur ba dang / dpag tu myed pa'i 'khor bas yongs su skyo ba myed cing / des kyang rlom sems su myi 'gyur ba dang / ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa la gnas kyang de rlom sems su myi 'gyur ba ste/ rab 'byor chos lnga po de dag ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa gsum pa la gnas pas gnas par bya ba dag go/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa bzhi pa la gnas pas/ chos bcu po 'di dag yongs su blangs shing gnas par bya ste/ de dag yongs su gtang bar myi bya'o/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dgon pa la gnas pa dang / 'dod pa chung ba dang / chog shes pa dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi sdom pa myi gtang ba dang / bslab pa yongs su myi gtang ba dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan la smad pa dang / mya ngan

las 'da' ba dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa dang / rdzas thams cad yongs su gtang ba dang / sems zhum pa myed pa dang / dngos po thams cad la ltos pa myed pa ste/ rab 'byor chos bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa bzhi pa la gnas pas yongs su gtang bar myi bya zhing yang dag par blangs te gnas par bya ba dag go/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa lnga pa la gnas pas chos drug po 'di dag yongs su spang bar bya ste/ drug gang zhe na/ 'di ltar khyim pa dang bsten pa yongs su spang bar bya ba dang / dge slong ma dang bsten pa dang / rigs la ser sna byed pa dang / 'du 'dzi'i gnas dang / gnod sems dang / bdag stod cing gzhan smod pa ste/ chos drug po de dag ni yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /yang chos bcwo brgyad yongs su spang bar bya ste/ 'di ltar myi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /lhag pa'i nga rgyal dang / khengs pa dang / phyin ci log rnams dang / the tsom dang / 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang / gti mug nyam rangs su mi 'dor ba ste/ chos bcwo brgyad po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa lnga pa la gnas pas yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa drug pa la gnas pas chos drug yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ 'di ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug go/ /gzhan yang chos drug yongs su spang bar bya ste/ chos drug gang zhe na/ nyan thos kyi sems yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi sems yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /sred pa'i sems yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /slongs mo ba mthong na zhum pa myed par bya ste/ zhum pa'i sems yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /dngos po thams cad yongs su btang bas yid myi bde bar myi bya ste/

yid myi bde ba yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /slongs mo ba mthong na slongs mo bas 'khrug par myi bya ste/ 'khrug pa'i sems yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /rab 'byor chos drug po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa drug pa la gnas pas yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa bdun pa la gnas pas chos nyi shu myi bya ste/ nyi shu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bdag tu 'dzin par myi bya'o/ /sems can du 'dzin par myi bya'o/ /srog tu 'dzin par myi bya'o/ /gang zag tu 'dzin par myi bya'o/ /chad par 'dzin par myi bya'o/ /rtag par 'dzin par myi bya'o/ /mtshan ma'i 'du shes su myi bya'o/ /rgyur lta ba dang / mying dang gzugs la mngon par chags pa dang / phung po la mngon par chags pa dang / khams la mngon par chags pa dang / skye mched la mngon par chags pa dang / khams gsum la mngon par chags pa dang / khams gsum la mngon par zhen pa dang / khams gsum la rten pa dang / khams gsum la gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas la rten pa'i lta ba la mngon par chags pa dang / chos la rten pa'i lta ba la mngon par chags pa dang / dge 'dun la rten pa'i lta ba la mngon par chags pa dang / tshul khrims la rten pa'i lta ba la mngon par chags pa dang / chos rnams stong ngo zhes zhum par 'gyur ba dang / stong pa nyid dang 'gal ba ste/ rab 'byor chos nyi shu po de dag ni bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /des chos nyi shu po 'di dag yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ nyi shu gang zhe na/ stong pa nyid rdzogs par bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed pa mngon du bya ba dang / smon pa myed pa shes par bya ba dang / 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa dang / sems can thams cad la snying rje zhing snying brtse ba dang / sems can de dag la brnyas

par myi bya ba dang / chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du lta ba dang / yang dag pa'i tshul rab tu rtogs shing / des rlom sems su myi bya ba dang / myi skye ba la bzod pa dang / myi skye ba shes pa dang / chos thams cad tshul gcig tu bstan pa dang / rtog pa yang dag par bstsal ba dang / 'du shes dang / lta ba rnam par bzlog pa dang / nyon mongs pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong gi sa dang / dul ba'i sems dang / zhi ba'i sems dang / thogs pa myed pa dang / byams pa'i skabs shes pa dang / gang du 'dod pa'i zhing du 'gro ba dang / thams cad du bdag gi ngo bo ston pa ste/ rab 'byor chos nyi shu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa bdun pa la gnas pas yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa brgyad pa la gnas pas chos bzhi po 'di dag yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi sems khong du chud par bya ba dang / mngon par shes pas rnam par rtse ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing blta zhing sangs rgyas kyi zhing ji ltar mthong ba de dag yongs su bsgrub pa dang / sangs rgyas bsnyen bkur zhing sangs rgyas kyi sku yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du brtag pa ste/ rab 'byor bzhi po de dag ni yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i chos so/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa brgyad pa la gnas pas chos bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dbang po rab dang tha ma shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyang ba dang / sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la yang dang yang mnyam par gzhag par bya ba dang / sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ji lta ji ltar 'grub par 'gyur ba de lta de ltar lus yongs su bsgrub pa'i phyir ched du bsams shing srid pa nye bar len pa ste/ rab 'byor

chos bzhi po de dag ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos brgyad pa la gnas pas yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa dgu pa la gnas pas chos bcu gnyis yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ bcu gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di ltar smon lam mtha' yas pa yongs su gzung ba ste/ ji lta ji ltar smon pa de lta de ltar phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i skad shes pa dang / yongs su rdzogs pa'i spobs pas nges par bstan pa shes pa dang / ma'i mngal du 'gro ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / rigs phun sum tshogs pa dang / rgyud phun sum tshogs pa dang / rus phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang / tshe phun sum tshogs pa dang / mngon par 'byung ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / byang chub kyi shing gi rgyan phun sum tshogs pa dang / yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa ste/ rab 'byor chos bcu gnyis po de dag ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos dgu pa la gnas pas yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'o/ /rab 'byor sa bcu pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du brjod do/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lhag pa'i bsam pa las stsogs pa yongs su sbyang ba gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba

mang po yang dag par sdud pa 'di ni/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lhag pa'i bsam pa las stsogs pa yongs su sbyang ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i phan pa'i dngos po yongs su sbyang ba gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang sems can thams cad kyi don du theg pa chen po'i ye shes tshol zhing sgrub par byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i phan pa'i dngos po yongs su sbyang ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid yongs su sbyang ba gang zhe na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas/ /tshad myed pa bzhi ste/ byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms mngon par bsgrub pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid yongs su sbyang ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i gtong ba yongs su sbyang ba gang zhe na/ sems can thams cad la rnam par rtog pa myed par sbyin pa de yongs su gtong ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i gtong ba yongs su sbyang ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa yongs su sbyang ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gang de la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yang dag par skul ba dang / gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog par byed pa de dag ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag la bsten pa dang / rim gror bya ba dang / bkur stir bya ba dang bla ma la phu dud du bya ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa yongs su sbyang ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos btsal ba yongs su sbyang ba gang zhe na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas chos tshol zhing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sar myi ltung ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos btsal ba yongs

su sbyang ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i yang dang yang 'byung ba yongs su sbyang ba gang zhe na/ tshe rabs thams cad du 'du 'dzi myed par 'byung zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rab tu 'byung yang de la bar chad byed pa gang yang myed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i yang dang yang 'byung ba yongs su sbyang ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sangs rgyas kyi sku la mos pa yongs su sbyang ba gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mthong nas/ nam rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par gyur gyi bar du/ sangs rgyas yid la bya ba dang nam yang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sangs rgyas kyi sku la mos pa yongs su sbyang ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos rnam par dbye ba yongs su sbyang ba gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa mngon du gyur pa'am/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe/ sems can rnams la chos ston cing / thog mar yang dge ba bar du yang dge ba tha mar yang dge ba/ yi ge bzang po/ don bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba'i tshangs pa'i spyod pa 'di lta ste/ mdo dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa dang / lung bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi dang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / rmad du byung ba dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / gtan la bab pa bstan pa dag yang dag par ston pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos rnam par dbye ba yongs su sbyang ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i nga rgyal dang / khengs pa

bstsal ba yongs su sbyang ba gang zhe na/ nga rgyal dang / khengs pa ji ltar bstsal ba des/ nam yang rigs dma' bar myi skye ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i nga rgyal dang / khengs pa bstsal ba yongs su sbyang ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bden pa'i tshig yongs su sbyang ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ji skad du smras pa de ltar byed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bden pa'i tshig yongs su sbyang ba'o/ /rab 'byor de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa dang po la gnas pa'i yongs su sbyang ba bcu'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims yongs su dag pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sems yid la myi byed cing / de ma yin pa'i tshul khrims ngan par byed pa dang / byang chub kyi bgegs su 'gyur ba'i chos gzhan dag kyang yid la myi byed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims yongs su dag pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byas pa shes shing drin du gzo ba gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ phan pa chung ngu zhig byas kyang 'khor ba zad kyi bar du chud mi gzon na/ mang po lta ci smos te/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byas pa shes shing drin du gzo ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'i mthu la gnas pa gang zhe na/ sems can thams cad la gnod sems myed cing 'tshe ba myed pa'i sems te/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'i mthu la gnas pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rab tu dga' zhing spro ba myong bar bya ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can thams

cad theg pa gsum la yongs su smyin par byed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rab tu dga' zhing spro ba myong bar bya ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems can thams cad yongs su myi gtang ba gang zhe na/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad yongs su skyob pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems can thams cad yongs su myi gtang ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i snying rje chen po mngon du bya ba gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ 'di snyam du sems shing bdag gis sems can re re'i don du yang bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du sems can dmyal bar gnas par bya ste/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la ma bkod kyi bar du/ de dag du gtub cing gsheg pa dang / brdung zhing btso ba dang / bsreg pa las stsogs pa nyams su myong bar bya'o snyam ste/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi don tu spro zhing skyo ba myed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i snying rje chen po mngon du bya ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bla ma bsnyen bkur zhing dad pas gus par bya ba gang zhe na/ 'di ltar bla ma rnams la ston pa'i 'du shes su byed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bla ma bsnyen bkur zhing dad pas gus par bya ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la brtson zhing tshol ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ las gzhan myed par sems can thams cad yongs su smyin par bya ba'i phyir las gzhan med par pha rol tu phyin pa rnams yongs su tshol ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la brtson zhing tshol ba'o/ /de la

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mang du thos pas myi ngoms pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'am/ phyogs bcu kun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su gang ji bstan pa de dag thams cad yongs su gzung bar bya'o/ /zhes myi ngoms pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mang du thos pas myi ngoms pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i zang zing myed par chos kyi sbyin pa rnam par 'byed pa gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos ston pa'i tshe/ chos kyi sbyin pa des chung du na byang chub du yang re ba myed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i zang zing med par chos kyi sbyin pa rnam par 'byed pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba skyed cing yongs su sngo ba gang zhe na/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gang gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed cing / bdag dang gzhan gyi sems kyi zhing yongs su sbyong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su sngo ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba skyed cing yongs su sngo ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dpag tu myed pa'i 'khor bas yongs su skyo ba med pa gang zhe na/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gang gis nye bar brten na/ sems can yongs su smyin par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa bas nye bar rton cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su rdzogs kyi bar du nam yang skyo bar myi 'gyur ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dpag tu myed pa'i 'khor bas yongs su skyo ba myed pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen

po'i ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa la gnas pa gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sems la smod pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa la gnas pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dgon pa la gnas pa yongs su myi gtang ba gang zhe na/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyis las 'da' ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dgon pa la gnas pa yongs su myi gtang ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'dod pa chung ba gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byang chub la yang 'dod pa myi skyed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'dod pa chung ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chog shes pa gang zhe na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob kyang rlom sems su myi byed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chog shes pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi sdom pa myi gtang ba gang zhe na/ 'di ltar chos zab mo rnams la rtog par gzhog pa'i bzod pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi sdom pa myi gtang ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bslab pa yongs su myi gtang ba gang zhe na/ bslab pa thams cad rgyu ba myed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bslab pa yongs su myi gtang ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'dod pa'i yon tan la smad pa gang zhe na/ 'dod pa'i sems myi skyed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'dod pa'i yon tan la smad pa'o/ /de la byang chub

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mya ngan las 'da' ba dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa gang zhe na/ 'di ltar chos thams cad mngon par 'du byed pa myed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mya ngan las 'da' ba dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rdzas thams cad yongs su gtang ba gang zhe na/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad la 'dzin pa myed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rdzas thams cad yongs su gtang ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems zhum pa myed pa gang zhe na/ rnam par shes pa gnas pa la de'i sems myi gnas pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems zhum pa myed pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dngos po thams cad la ltos pa myed pa gang zhe na/ dngos po thams cad yid la myi byed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dngos po thams cad la ltos pa myed pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i khyim pa dang bsten pa yongs su spang bar bya ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro zhing rdzus te skye ba dang / mgo bregs shing ngur smrig gi gos bgo ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i khyim pa dang bsten pa yongs su spang bar bya ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge slong ma dang bsten pa yongs su spang ba gang zhe na/ dge slong ma dang se go la gtogs pa tsam du yang lhan cig myi gnas shing / de'i rgyus yongs su skom pa'i sems mi skyed cing / de'i rgyus gos 'thob par myi byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge slong ma dang bsten pa yongs su spang bar bya ba'o/ /de la
